summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct the signatory title in a prior 8-K and disclose a letter agreement with EOS Technology Holdings Inc. allowing EOS to elect stock instead of cash for earnout payments under a December 31, 2024 Earnout Agreement. Stock issuance is priced at $0.61 per share for the December 31, 2025 earnout period, capped at 19.99% of outstanding shares unless stockholder approval is obtained. The agreement modifies payment mechanics only; no new transaction, offer, or strategic action is involved. What to watch: potential dilution from stock elections and whether EOS exercises the option.
